# Spline modeling

## 10 fold CV

```{r}
set.seed(1)
k_fold_result <- createFolds(data$재산피해금액, k=10, list=TRUE, returnTrain = FALSE)
```


## Col을 연속형과 이산형으로 분류

```{r}
continuous_cols <- data %>%
  select(-재산피해금액, -화재발생연도) %>%
  select_if(is.numeric) %>%
  names()

factor_cols <-data %>%
  select(-재산피해금액) %>%
  select_if(is.factor) %>%
  names()

continuous_terms <- paste0(continuous_cols, collapse = " + ")
factor_terms <- paste0(factor_cols, collapse = " + ")
interaction_continuous_terms <- combn(continuous_cols, 2, FUN=function(x) paste0(x[1], ":", x[2]))
interaction_continuous_terms <- paste0(interaction_continuous_terms, collapse=" + ")
interaction_cont_factor_terms <- paste0(paste(factor_cols, continuous_cols, sep = ":"), collapse = " + ")
interaction_factor_terms <- combn(factor_cols, 2, FUN=function(x) paste0(x[1], ":", x[2]))
interaction_factor_terms <- paste0(interaction_factor_terms, collapse = " + ")
```

## MLR

```{r, warning = FALSE}
formula <- paste("재산피해금액 ~ ", factor_terms, "+", continuous_terms)

Fold_MSE <- c()
for (i in seq_along(k_fold_result)) {
  # Iteration number
  print(i)
  
  # i번째 fold를 테스트 데이터로 사용
  test <- data[k_fold_result[[i]], ]
  
  # 나머지 fold를 학습 데이터로 사용
  train <- data[-k_fold_result[[i]], ]
  
  model <- lm(formula = as.formula(formula), data = train)
  
  # i번째 fold에 대한 결과 저장
  Fold_MSE <- c(Fold_MSE, sum((test$재산피해금액-predict(model, test))^2)/(dim(test)[1]-dim(train)[1]+model$df.residual))
}
```

```{r}
mean(Fold_MSE)
```

### Adj R^2, AIC, BIC, Mallow Cp

```{r}
model <- lm(formula = as.formula(formula), data = data)
RSS <- sum((summary(model)$residuals)^2) # Residual Sum of Squares

AIC <- dim(data)[1]*log(RSS/dim(data)[1]) + 2*(summary(model)$df[1]+1)
BIC <- dim(data)[1]*log(RSS/dim(data)[1]) + log(dim(data)[1])*(summary(model)$df[1]+1)

AIC
BIC
summary(model)$adj.r.squared
summary(model)$df
```

```{r}
par(mfrow = c(2,2))
plot(model)
```

# Spline

## Natural Spline of degree of many degree of freedoms on continuous

```{r, warning=FALSE}
Fold_MSE_df <- vector(mode = "list", length = 8)
AIC <- c()
BIC <- c()
Adj.R.squared <- c()
params <- c()


for (df in 2:8){
  print(df)
  df_command <- paste(", df = ", df, ")")
  spline_df_command <- paste(df_command, " + splines::ns(")
  
  spline_continuous_terms <- paste0(continuous_cols, collapse = spline_df_command)
spline_continuous_terms <- paste("splines::ns(", spline_continuous_terms, df_command)

  formula <- paste("재산피해금액 ~ ", factor_terms, "+ 화재발생연도 +", spline_continuous_terms)

  for (i in seq_along(k_fold_result)) {
  
    # i번째 fold를 테스트 데이터로 사용
    test <- data[k_fold_result[[i]], ]
  
    # 나머지 fold를 학습 데이터로 사용
    train <- data[-k_fold_result[[i]], ]
  
    model <- lm(formula = as.formula(formula), data = train)
  
    # i번째 fold에 대한 결과 저장
    Fold_MSE_df[[df]] <- c(Fold_MSE_df[[df]], sum((test$재산피해금액-predict(model, test))^2)/(dim(test)[1]-dim(train)[1]+model$df.residual))
  }
  
  model <- lm(formula = as.formula(formula), data = data)
  RSS <- sum((summary(model)$residuals)^2) # Residual Sum of Squares

  AIC_model <- dim(data)[1]*log(RSS/dim(data)[1]) + 2*(summary(model)$df[1]+1)
  BIC_model <- dim(data)[1]*log(RSS/dim(data)[1]) + log(dim(data)[1])*(summary(model)$df[1]+1)
  
  AIC <- c(AIC, AIC_model)
  BIC <- c(BIC, BIC_model)
  Adj.R.squared <- c(Adj.R.squared, summary(model)$adj.r.squared)
  params <- c(params, summary(model)$df[1])
  
  print(summary(model)$df)
}
```

```{r}
CVMSE <- c(mean(Fold_MSE_df[[2]]), mean(Fold_MSE_df[[3]]), mean(Fold_MSE_df[[4]]), mean(Fold_MSE_df[[5]]), mean(Fold_MSE_df[[6]]), mean(Fold_MSE_df[[7]]), mean(Fold_MSE_df[[8]]))
```

### Plot

```{r}
df <- c(2,3,4,5,6,7,8)
max_first  <- max(CVMSE)   # Specify max of first y axis
max_second <- max(max(-AIC), max(-BIC)) # Specify max of second y axis
min_first  <- min(Adj.R.squared)   # Specify min of first y axis
min_second <- min(min(-AIC), min(-BIC)) # Specify min of second y axis

# scale and shift variables calculated based on desired mins and maxes
scale = (max_second - min_second)/(max_first - min_first)
shift = min_first - min_second

# Function to scale secondary axis
scale_function <- function(x){
  return ((x-min_first)*scale + min_second)
}

# Function to scale secondary variable values
inv_scale_function <- function(x){
  return ((x-min_second)/scale + min_first)
}

p <- as.data.frame(cbind(df, CVMSE, -AIC, -BIC, Adj.R.squared)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = df))+
  geom_point(aes(y = Adj.R.squared, color = "Adj R^2"), size = 0.5)+
  geom_point(aes(y = inv_scale_function(V3), color = "-AIC"), size = 0.5)+
  geom_point(aes(y = inv_scale_function(V4), color = "-BIC"), size = 0.5)+
  geom_point(aes(y = CVMSE, color = "CVMSE"), size = 0.5)+
  geom_line(aes(y = Adj.R.squared, color = "Adj R^2"))+
  geom_line(aes(y = CVMSE, color = "CVMSE"))+
  geom_line(aes(y = inv_scale_function(V3), color = "-AIC")) +
  geom_line(aes(y = inv_scale_function(V4), color = "-BIC")) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    # Features of the first axis
    name = "CVMSE, Adj R^2",
    
    # Add a second axis and specify its features
    sec.axis = sec_axis(~scale_function(.), name="AIC, BIC (negative value)"),
    n.breaks = 4
) +
  ggtitle("CVMSE, AIC, BIC, Adj R^2 comparison")+
  scale_color_manual(values = c("orange1", "orange3", "grey50", "red"))+
  theme(
    
    plot.title = element_text(size = 20, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
    axis.title.y = element_text(color = "gray30"),
    axis.title.y.right = element_text(color = "orange2"),
    panel.background = element_blank(),
    axis.line = element_line(colour = "black"),
    text = element_text(size = 15, face = "bold"),
    legend.key.size = unit(0.4, "cm"),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 15, face = "bold")
  )+
  labs(colour = "Criteria")+
  xlab("Degree of Spline")

p
```

### Natural Spline of degree of many degree of freedoms on continuous & continous term's interaction

```{r, warning=FALSE}
Fold_MSE_df <- vector(mode = "list", length = 8)
AIC <- c()
BIC <- c()
Adj.R.squared <- c()
params <- c()


for (df in 1:8){
  print(df)
  df_command <- paste(", df = ", df, ")")
  spline_df_command <- paste(df_command, " + splines::ns(")
  
  spline_continuous_terms <- paste0(continuous_cols, collapse = spline_df_command)
spline_continuous_terms <- paste("splines::ns(", spline_continuous_terms, df_command)
  spline_interaction_continuous_terms <- combn(continuous_cols, 2, FUN=function(x) paste0(x[1], "*", x[2]))
  spline_interaction_continuous_terms <- paste0(spline_interaction_continuous_terms, collapse = spline_df_command)
  spline_interaction_continuous_terms <- paste("splines::ns(", spline_interaction_continuous_terms, df_command)
  
  formula <- paste("재산피해금액 ~ ", factor_terms, "+ 화재발생연도 +", spline_continuous_terms, "+", spline_interaction_continuous_terms)

  for (i in seq_along(k_fold_result)) {
  
    # i번째 fold를 테스트 데이터로 사용
    test <- data[k_fold_result[[i]], ]
  
    # 나머지 fold를 학습 데이터로 사용
    train <- data[-k_fold_result[[i]], ]
  
    model <- lm(formula = as.formula(formula), data = train)
  
    # i번째 fold에 대한 결과 저장
    Fold_MSE_df[[df]] <- c(Fold_MSE_df[[df]], sum((test$재산피해금액-predict(model, test))^2)/(dim(test)[1]-dim(train)[1]+model$df.residual))
  }
  model <- lm(formula = as.formula(formula), data = data)
  RSS <- sum((summary(model)$residuals)^2) # Residual Sum of Squares

  AIC_model <- dim(data)[1]*log(RSS/dim(data)[1]) + 2*(summary(model)$df[1]+1)
  BIC_model <- dim(data)[1]*log(RSS/dim(data)[1]) + log(dim(data)[1])*(summary(model)$df[1]+1)
  
  AIC <- c(AIC, AIC_model)
  BIC <- c(BIC, BIC_model)
  Adj.R.squared <- c(Adj.R.squared, summary(model)$adj.r.squared)
  
  print(summary(model)$df)
  params <- c(params, summary(model)$df[1])
}
```

# Spline with Lasso

```{r}
df = 1
grid <- 10^seq(5, -5, length = 100)

xfactor <- data[, factor_cols, drop = FALSE]

xyear <- data[["화재발생연도"]]

dummies <- lapply(xfactor, function(x) model.matrix(~x - 1, x))
# combine dummy variables with original data
xdummies <- do.call(cbind, dummies)
  
 
xcont <- data[, continuous_cols, drop = FALSE]
xspline <- lapply(seq_along(colnames(xcont)), function(i) {
  ns(xcont[, i], df = df)
})
xspline <- do.call(cbind, xspline)
  
  
CVMSE_lambda_1 <- rep(0, 100)
  
for(i in 1:10){
  # i번째 fold를 테스트 데이터로 사용
  test <- data[k_fold_result[[i]], ]
  
  # 나머지 fold를 학습 데이터로 사용
  train <- data[-k_fold_result[[i]], ]
  
  xspline.i <- xspline[-k_fold_result[[i]],]
  xdummies.i <- xdummies[-k_fold_result[[i]],]
  xspline._i <- xspline[k_fold_result[[i]],]
  xdummies._i <- xdummies[k_fold_result[[i]],]
  xyear.i <- xyear[-k_fold_result[[i]]]
  xyear._i <- xyear[k_fold_result[[i]]]
    
  x <- cbind(xdummies.i, xspline.i, xyear.i)
  y <- train$재산피해금액
    
  lasso.mod <- glmnet(x, y, alpha = 1, lambda = grid)
  for(j in 1:100){
    lasso.pred <- predict(lasso.mod, s = grid[j], newx = cbind(xdummies._i, xspline._i, xyear._i))
    lasso.coef <- predict(lasso.mod, type = "coefficients", s = grid[j])
    CVMSE_lambda_1[j] = CVMSE_lambda_1[j] + sum((lasso.pred - test$재산피해금액)^2)/(dim(test)[1] - sum(lasso.coef != 0))
  }
}

CVMSE_lambda_1 = CVMSE_lambda_1 / 10

```

```{r}

  xdummies._i <- xdummies[k_fold_result[[i]],]
  
  xyear.i <- xyear[-k_fold_result[[i]]]
  xyear._i <- xyear[k_fold_result[[i]]]
```

```{r}
CVMSE <- as.data.frame(cbind(grid, CVMSE_lambda_1, CVMSE_lambda_2, CVMSE_lambda_3, CVMSE_lambda_4, CVMSE_lambda_5, CVMSE_lambda_6, CVMSE_lambda_7, CVMSE_lambda_8))

df1_min <- CVMSE[which.min(CVMSE_lambda_1),]
df2_min <- CVMSE[which.min(CVMSE_lambda_2),]
df3_min <- CVMSE[which.min(CVMSE_lambda_3),]
df4_min <- CVMSE[which.min(CVMSE_lambda_4),]
df5_min <- CVMSE[which.min(CVMSE_lambda_5),]
df6_min <- CVMSE[which.min(CVMSE_lambda_6),]
df7_min <- CVMSE[which.min(CVMSE_lambda_7),]
df8_min <- CVMSE[which.min(CVMSE_lambda_8),]

p <- CVMSE%>%
  filter(grid < 1)%>%
  ggplot(aes(x = log(grid, base = 10)))+
  geom_point(aes(y = CVMSE_lambda_1, color = "df 1"), size = 0.1)+
  geom_line(aes(y = CVMSE_lambda_1, color = "df 1"), size = 0.1)+

  geom_line(aes(y = CVMSE_lambda_4, color = "df 4"), size = 0.1)+
  geom_point(aes(y = CVMSE_lambda_5, color = "df 5"), size = 0.1)+
  geom_line(aes(y = CVMSE_lambda_5, color = "df 5"), size = 0.1)+

  geom_point(aes(y = CVMSE_lambda_7, color = "df 7"), size = 0.1)+
  geom_line(aes(y = CVMSE_lambda_7, color = "df 7"), size = 0.1)+
  geom_point(aes(y = CVMSE_lambda_8, color = "df 8"), size = 0.1)+
  geom_line(aes(y = CVMSE_lambda_8, color = "df 8"), size = 0.1)+
  geom_point(data = df1_min, aes(x = log(grid, base = 10), y = CVMSE_lambda_1), color = "red", size = 0.1)+
  geom_point(data = df2_min, aes(x = log(grid, base = 10), y = CVMSE_lambda_2), color = "red", size = 0.1)+
  geom_point(data = df3_min, aes(x = log(grid, base = 10), y = CVMSE_lambda_3), color = "red", size = 0.1)+

  geom_vline(xintercept = -1.868687, color = "red", size = 0.1, linetype = "dotted")+
```

### Adj R^2, AIC, BIC

```{r}
AIC <- c()
BIC <- c()
Adj.R.squared <- c()
CVMSE <- c(df2_min[[3]], df3_min[[4]], df4_min[[5]], df5_min[[6]], df6_min[[7]], df7_min[[8]], df8_min[[9]])
```


```{r}
df = 2
bestlam = df2_min[[1]]

xfactor <- data[, factor_cols, drop = FALSE]

dummies <- lapply(xfactor, function(x) model.matrix(~x - 1, x))
# combine dummy variables with original data
xdummies <- do.call(cbind, dummies)
  
 
xcont <- data[, continuous_cols, drop = FALSE]
xspline <- lapply(seq_along(colnames(xcont)), function(i) {
  ns(xcont[, i], df = df)
})
xspline <- do.call(cbind, xspline)

xyear <- data[["화재발생연도"]]

x <- cbind(xdummies, xspline, xyear)
y <- data$재산피해금액
    
lasso.mod <- glmnet(x, y, alpha = 1, lambda = bestlam)

lasso.pred <- predict(lasso.mod, s = bestlam, newx = cbind(xdummies, xspline, xyear))
lasso.coef <- predict(lasso.mod, type = "coefficients", s = bestlam)
RSS <- sum((lasso.pred - data$재산피해금액)^2)

AIC <- c(AIC, dim(data)[1]*log(RSS/dim(data)[1]) + 2*(sum(lasso.coef != 0)))
BIC <- c(BIC, dim(data)[1]*log(RSS/dim(data)[1]) + log(dim(data)[1])*(sum(lasso.coef != 0)))

SST <- sum((data$재산피해금액 - mean(data$재산피해금액))^2)
Adj.R.squared <- c(Adj.R.squared, 1- RSS/SST * (dim(data)[1])/(dim(data)[1] - sum(lasso.coef != 0)))
```

```{r}
BIC <- c(BIC, dim(data)[1]*log(RSS/dim(data)[1]) + log(dim(data)[1])*(sum(lasso.coef != 0)))

SST <- sum((data$재산피해금액 - mean(data$재산피해금액))^2)
Adj.R.squared <- c(Adj.R.squared, 1- RSS/SST * (dim(data)[1])/(dim(data)[1] - sum(lasso.coef != 0)))
```

### Plot

```{r}
df <- c(2,3,4,5,6,7,8)
max_first  <- max(CVMSE)   # Specify max of first y axis
max_second <- max(max(-AIC), max(-BIC)) # Specify max of second y axis
min_first  <- min(Adj.R.squared)   # Specify min of first y axis
min_second <- min(min(-AIC), min(-BIC)) # Specify min of second y axis

# scale and shift variables calculated based on desired mins and maxes
scale = (max_second - min_second)/(max_first - min_first)
shift = min_first - min_second

# Function to scale secondary axis
scale_function <- function(x){
  return ((x-min_first)*scale + min_second)
}

# Function to scale secondary variable values
inv_scale_function <- function(x){
  return ((x-min_second)/scale + min_first)
}

p <- as.data.frame(cbind(df, CVMSE, -AIC, -BIC, Adj.R.squared)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = df))+
  geom_point(aes(y = Adj.R.squared, color = "Adj R^2"), size = 0.5)+
  geom_point(aes(y = inv_scale_function(V3), color = "-AIC"), size = 0.5)+
  geom_point(aes(y = inv_scale_function(V4), color = "-BIC"), size = 0.5)+
  geom_point(aes(y = CVMSE, color = "CVMSE"), size = 0.5)+
  geom_line(aes(y = Adj.R.squared, color = "Adj R^2"))+
  geom_line(aes(y = CVMSE, color = "CVMSE"))+
  geom_line(aes(y = inv_scale_function(V3), color = "-AIC")) +
  geom_line(aes(y = inv_scale_function(V4), color = "-BIC")) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    # Features of the first axis
    name = "CVMSE, Adj R^2",
    
    # Add a second axis and specify its features
    sec.axis = sec_axis(~scale_function(.), name="AIC, BIC (negative value)"),
    n.breaks = 4
) +
  ggtitle("CVMSE, AIC, BIC, Adj R^2 comparison")+
  scale_color_manual(values = c("orange1", "orange3", "grey50", "red"))+
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(size = 20, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
    axis.title.y = element_text(color = "gray30"),
    axis.title.y.right = element_text(color = "orange2"),
    panel.background = element_blank(),
    axis.line = element_line(colour = "black"),
    text = element_text(size = 15, face = "bold"),
    legend.key.size = unit(0.4, "cm"),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 15, face = "bold")
  )+
  labs(colour = "Criteria")+
  xlab("Degree of Spline")

p
```

# Comparison with GAM

```{r}
gam_result <- read.csv("/Users/donghyunpark/Documents/Seoul National University/3rd year 1st semester/Data mining/1차 프로젝트/1차 프로젝트 데이터/gam.csv", fileEncoding = "UTF-8")

gam_result <- gam_result %>%
  mutate(화재진압시간 = log(화재진압시간 + 1, base = 10)) %>%
  rename("Gam_Prediction" = "Prediction")

Fitted <- Fitted %>%
  mutate(X = row_number()) %>%
  rename("Spline_Prediction" = "Prediction")

Spline_Gam <- Fitted %>%
  left_join(gam_result, by = c("X")) %>%
  select("Spline_Prediction", "Gam_Prediction", "재산피해금액.x", "화재진압시간.x") %>%
  rename("재산피해금액" = "재산피해금액.x", "화재진압시간" = "화재진압시간.x")
```
